headline: Names a post office building in Corning, New York, after Specialist Ryan P. Jayne.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 198 Baker Street in Corning, New York, as the "Specialist Ryan P. Jayne Post Office Building." It is a naming measure only and does not change how the post office operates. The official summary does not describe any other changes.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on August 8, 2014.
